title: Starz Logo Recreation
coreRelationships: The logotype 'STARZ' is the primary subject, dynamically integrated with a star graphic.
The letters of 'STARZ' are constructed with sharp, angular forms that echo the points of the star.
Wing-like elements extend from the 'Z' and 'S' of 'STARZ', suggesting speed or flight.
A circular outline partially encompasses the star and logotype, providing a subtle counterpoint to the sharp angles.
reuseFormula: Recreate the custom-lettered 'STARZ' logotype with its distinctive angular forms and integrated wing elements. Position it centrally within and around a sharp, five-pointed star graphic. All elements should be a vibrant yellow against a solid black background, maintaining high contrast and a dynamic, aggressive aesthetic.
